entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Study hall will be held instead of PE[n]today. I'm letting you know just in case[n]you haven't heard.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Mr. Kamoshida has taken the day off.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Don't tell anyone that you heard this[n]from me...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: But we received word that Mr. Kamoshida[n]is placing himself under suspension.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: It's such an important time before[n]the tournament too...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Principal Kobayakawa went to talk[n]to him about it, but he supposedly[n]wasn't making any sense...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: The talks about your expulsions may be[n]put on hold too... I don't know too much[n]about it though...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Anyway, I've relayed what's going on[n]to you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: At least it sounds different from a mental[n]shutdown...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I guess all we can do is wait...
